turns.prompt_text: are hey Alexa what spice how should you spice a chicken
turns.response_html: To properly spice a chicken, pat it dry, brush with oil, and rub it with a seasoning blend like salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder. Common spices that work well on chicken are paprika, oregano, thyme, rosemary, cumin, and cayenne pepper.
